body:
Codex review: this still needs some work.

**Summary**
Keep open: current main and v2026.10.5 still discard Gateway error text at the ACP boundary, and the older error-kind request does not cover this distinct notice-delivery repair.

Reproducibility: Current source establishes the missing forwarding directly: an error event containing errorMessage reaches finishPrompt without a notice; the reporter supplies a mock-provider reproduction on official releases, but this review ran no tests or live reproduction.

**Next step**
Fix ACP error-message forwarding and length termination mapping, first establishing failing regressions for recorded failure text before settlement and partial answers ending at the token limit.


<details>
<summary>Review details</summary>

Best possible solution:

Record and emit the carried Gateway failure notice before ACP settlement, and translate native length termination to max_tokens.

Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue?

Current source establishes the missing forwarding directly: an error event containing errorMessage reaches finishPrompt without a notice; the reporter supplies a mock-provider reproduction on official releases, but this review ran no tests or live reproduction.

Is this the best way to solve the issue?

The existing recorded-interruption mechanism provides a focused repair without changing established refusal or end_turn settlement semantics; the optional JSON-RPC rejection proposal belongs with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44294.

AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant.

Remaining risk / open question:

- The partial-answer truncation case still needs a Gateway-to-ACP regression; existing coverage supplies max_tokens directly.

Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [9970230915c8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9970230915c8a058d22ee1156664f56bae1678d8).

</details>

<details>
<summary>Label changes</summary>

Label changes:

- add `P1`: Reported failures on an official release remain source-reproducible on main and silently break ACP editor and harness failure handling.
- add `impact:message-loss`: The Gateway's user-facing failure text never reaches the ACP message stream.
- add `impact:session-state`: ACP clients receive an ordinary terminal result for a failed or truncated turn and cannot accurately interpret its outcome.
- add `issue-rating: 🦞 diamond lobster`: Current issue advisory state selects this label.
- add `clawsweeper:source-repro`: Current issue advisory state selects this label.
- add `clawsweeper:queueable-fix`: Current issue advisory state selects this label.
- add `clawsweeper:fix-shape-clear`: Current issue advisory state selects this label.

Label justifications:

- `P1`: Reported failures on an official release remain source-reproducible on main and silently break ACP editor and harness failure handling.
- `impact:message-loss`: The Gateway's user-facing failure text never reaches the ACP message stream.
- `impact:session-state`: ACP clients receive an ordinary terminal result for a failed or truncated turn and cannot accurately interpret its outcome.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Evidence reviewed</summary>

Acceptance criteria:

- Establish red-on-base, green-on-fix coverage for visible and recorded errorMessage delivery before settlement, including refusal and non-refusal events.
- Establish red-on-base, green-on-fix coverage for native length mapping to max_tokens while preserving partial text.
- node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/acp/translator.error-kind.test.ts src/acp/translator.final-snapshots.test.ts src/acp/translator.stop-reason.test.ts src/acp/translator.session-updates.test.ts src/acp/translator.disconnects.test.ts src/acp/translator.cancel-scoping.test.ts
- Run the isolated Gateway-to-ACP stdio reproduction for reasoning-only length, content-filter failure, partial-text length, and normal stop; verify notice ordering and replay.
- pnpm check:changed

What I checked:

- **Current error text is discarded:** The error branch reads only errorKind and calls finishPrompt without errorMessage; finishPrompt resolves the stop reason and emits text only when an interruption is supplied. ([`src/acp/translator.prompt-stream.ts:492`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/9970230915c8a058d22ee1156664f56bae1678d8/src/acp/translator.prompt-stream.ts#L492), [9970230915c8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9970230915c8a058d22ee1156664f56bae1678d8))
- **Gateway already carries the missing information:** Returned agent failures are broadcast with errorMessage and the runtime stopReason, so preserving the visible failure does not require a new upstream classifier or protocol field. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-agent-dispatch.ts:620`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/9970230915c8a058d22ee1156664f56bae1678d8/src/gateway/server-methods/chat-send-agent-dispatch.ts#L620), [9970230915c8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9970230915c8a058d22ee1156664f56bae1678d8))
- **Truncation mapping and coverage gap:** The final branch recognizes max_tokens but not length. Existing final-snapshot coverage injects max_tokens directly, while the OpenAI provider normalizes a length finish to length. ([`src/acp/translator.prompt-stream.ts:480`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/9970230915c8a058d22ee1156664f56bae1678d8/src/acp/translator.prompt-stream.ts#L480), [9970230915c8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9970230915c8a058d22ee1156664f56bae1678d8))
- **Latest release remains affected:** The v2026.10.5 source has the same error branch without message forwarding and the same max_tokens-only final mapping. ([`src/acp/translator.prompt-stream.ts:481`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/1b58cb9a1b4f4353e1add63c8506db4d890962e8/src/acp/translator.prompt-stream.ts#L481), [1b58cb9a1b4f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1b58cb9a1b4f4353e1add63c8506db4d890962e8))
- **Established notice-delivery pattern:** Merged https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/132378 forwards aborted-event errorMessage into a recorded interruption before settlement; merged https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108827 establishes durable notices for disconnect rejection. Neither changes the live error-event branch. ([`src/acp/translator.prompt-stream.ts:486`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/8544aed05a5dbffb871483be781f71351203319e/src/acp/translator.prompt-stream.ts#L486), [8544aed05a5d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8544aed05a5dbffb871483be781f71351203319e))
- **Existing settlement contract:** Historical commit c2e2b87 added refusal-only classification while retaining end_turn for other errors. Current tests preserve that result contract but do not assert delivery of the supplied gateway error text. ([`src/acp/translator.error-kind.test.ts:8`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/c2e2b87f28f0fae2fa3b7395c66077be31ec74f7/src/acp/translator.error-kind.test.ts#L8), [c2e2b87f28f0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c2e2b87f28f0fae2fa3b7395c66077be31ec74f7))

</details>

<details>
<summary>How this review workflow works</summary>

- ClawSweeper keeps one durable marker-backed review comment per issue or PR.
- Re-runs edit this comment so the latest verdict, findings, and automation markers stay together instead of adding duplicate bot comments.
- A fresh review can be triggered by eligible `@clawsweeper re-review` comments, exact-item GitHub events, scheduled/background review runs, or manual workflow dispatch.
- PR/issue authors and users with repository write access can comment `@clawsweeper re-review` or `@clawsweeper re-run` on an open PR or issue to request a fresh review only.
- Maintainers can also comment `@clawsweeper review` to request a fresh review only.
- Fresh-review commands do not start repair, autofix, rebase, CI repair, or automerge; those execution lanes are retired.
- Maintainers can comment `@clawsweeper explain` to ask for more context, or `@clawsweeper stop` to stop active automation.

</details>
